# Tailor Brands

> Tailor Brands is an AI-powered platform that guides entrepreneurs through LLC formation, business registration, and brand building with intelligent automation and expert support.

Tailor Brands combines legal business formation services (LLC setup, EIN filing, compliance management) with creative branding tools (AI logo maker) and an intelligent AI co-founder called Navi that manages filings, deadlines, and business growth strategies. The platform serves as an all-in-one solution for startup setup and management.

## Key Topics

- LLC Formation
- EIN (Employer Identification Number)
- Navi AI Co-founder
- Business Formation
- Compliance Management
- Articles of Organization
- LLC Operating Agreement
- Business Registration
- AI Logo Maker
- Online Filing
- Startup Platform
- Tax Requirements
- Business Coaching
- Legal Compliance
- Dashboard Tools

## Core Business Formation Services

- [Start an LLC Online | Complete 2026 LLC Formation Guide](https://www.tailorbrands.com/llc-formation): Primary LLC formation service page with EIN, Articles of Organization, and compliance guidance.
- [Get an EIN Online In Just a Few Steps | Tailor Brands](https://www.tailorbrands.com/products/ein): EIN application service page for IRS Employer Identification Number filing.
- [Get a Business Formation Kit](https://www.tailorbrands.com/products/formation-kit): Business Formation Kit product for organizing legal documents and compliance materials.

## AI-Powered Business Tools & Guidance

- [Navi AI - Tailor Brands](https://www.tailorbrands.com/products/navi): Navi AI co-founder product managing filings, deadlines, and business growth.
- [AI Logo Maker | Easily Make a Unique Logo | Tailor Brands](https://www.tailorbrands.com/logo-maker): AI-powered Logo Maker tool for creating custom brand identity designs.

## Business Growth & Support Programs

- [Business Coaching Program](https://www.tailorbrands.com/products/business-coaching-program): 12-week Business Coaching Program for LLC formation with financial and marketing guidance.

## Platform Overview

- [Set up, Manage & Grow Your Business with Tailor Brands](https://www.tailorbrands.com): Homepage showcasing Tailor Brands' guided business building platform with Navi AI.
